meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Oily skin ke liye **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Face Wash** sabse achha budget option hai—lagbhag ₹299/100 ml. Salicylic acid pores unclog karke excess oil aur blackheads mein madad karta hai.[2][3]

### Skin concern ke hisaab se options

- **Oily + acne/blackheads:** Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA — ~₹278–₹299.[2]
- **Oily but sensitive skin:** Simple Kind to Skin Refreshing Face Wash — ~₹224–₹450; fragrance-free gentle option.[1][9]
- **Daily budget cleansing:** Himalaya Purifying Neem Face Wash — ~₹120–₹250.[1][6]
- **Oily + dull skin:** Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash — ~₹239–₹349.[6][9]
- **Oily skin with frequent pimples:** The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash — ~₹263–₹299.[2]

**Meri recommendation:** Minimalist ko pehle **haftे mein 3–4 baar**, preferably raat ko, use karein; irritation na ho to daily once kar sakte hain. Face wash ke baad lightweight, non-comedogenic moisturiser aur din mein sunscreen lagayein. Agar skin sensitive hai ya acne treatment chal raha hai, to Simple choose karein—salicylic acid ko overuse na karein.
